<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/account/{account}/webhooks/failed/{delivery}/retry"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Puts a webhook delivery that failed for good back into the queue with a fresh set of attempts. It is sent to the target the event was queued for, with the payload it was queued with. A delivery that is not in the failed state answers 409 with `code` NotFailed.
